stem: Which lines from the poem “Wisdom in Wishes” use figurative language to build a sense of happiness?

options.label: A
options.text: As a child of five,  I pranced outside, (lines 1–2)

options.label: B
options.text: Instead I sit,  Enclosed in warm walls, (lines 10–11)

options.label: C
options.text: Then I hear  A childish whisper— (lines 19–20)

options.label: D
options.text: A smile begins  The trip over my face. (lines 25–26)
